name: Boots of the Winterlands

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Resistance to Cold; snow and ice don't slow you; you're comfortable in bitter cold.
text: These furred boots are snug and feel warm. While you wear them, you gain the following benefits: you have Resistance to Cold damage; you ignore Difficult Terrain created by ice or snow; and you can tolerate temperatures as low as -50 degrees Fahrenheit without any additional protection.
